The Private Residences at Hotel Georgia — 667 Howe Street

A 48-storey tower beside the historic 1927 Hotel Georgia: 156 luxury condominiums on floors 14 to 48 above office and hotel floors, completed in 2012 per current listings and the building's project history (a building directory gives 2013, so sources differ on the year). Listings record Freehold Strata title, concrete and glass construction, and Downtown VW sub-area. The building directory records the strata bylaws as pets allowed with restrictions and rentals allowed.

Streets, schools and getting around Downtown VW

items.t: Downtown VW is the downtown peninsula's Vancouver West board side: the central business district and the Georgia / Granville / Burrard / Robson core, on Burrard Inlet's south shore. The City describes the containing Downtown local area as a peninsula bounded by Burrard Inlet on the north, False Creek and Yaletown to the south, the West End and Stanley Park to the west, and Gastown, Chinatown and Strathcona to the east.
Detached houses are not a VW-core housing form.

Main streets: West Georgia Street, Granville Street, Burrard Street and Howe Street. The City's Downtown history names Georgia and Granville Streets as the city-centre streets the centre moved up to from Water and Cordova Streets after incorporation.

Transit anchors: the core is the hub where the Expo Line, Millennium Line and Canada Line meet (Waterfront and Burrard stations); the R5 Hastings St RapidBus terminates at Burrard Station, route 22 also runs from Burrard Station, and route 50 starts at Waterfront Station and runs via Chinatown, Granville Island and the False Creek south shore to Olympic Village Station.

Civic anchors in the core: Vancouver Public Library Central Library, 350 West Georgia Street, and St. Paul's Hospital, 1081 Burrard Street — a Providence Health Care hospital, not a Vancouver Coastal Health site.

blocks.text: Good to know about Downtown VW

items.t: The city centre moved uphill, and the VW core is where it landed. The City states the first passenger train arrived at the foot of Howe Street in 1887, and that in the next seven years a building boom moved the city centre from Water and Cordova Streets up to Georgia and Granville Streets — the streets at the heart of today's VW core; streetcar service began in 1890.

The Hotel Georgia residences start where the old hotel's crown ends. The 156 Private Residences begin on floor 14, just above the crown of the 1927 Hotel Georgia, and run to a penthouse that is the entire 48th floor — a unit's floor determines whether it sits in the historic hotel's podium shadow or the glass spire above it.

The VW core has a hospital but no confirmed core elementary. St. Paul's Hospital at 1081 Burrard Street is a genuine in-area amenity on the Burrard corridor, while the two Downtown elementaries sit at the area's south and east edges and no secondary school inside the area was confirmed — family buyers should run the VSB locator before assuming anything.

Tate's townhouses hide at the base of a 40-storey tower. The Tate Downtown development includes ground-oriented townhouse units (documented at 513 – 1283 Howe Street) inside a 333-unit strata whose manager records completion in 2018 — a buyer who filters searches to "townhouse" only, or to "apartment" only, sees only part of one development.

No park, community centre or pool in the VW core was confirmed by name on a City page pass — the Coal Harbour Community Centre sits in the separate Coal Harbour sub-area and the West End's facilities sit in a separate local area, so neither is claimed here; the Central Library at 350 West Georgia Street is the core's confirmed civic anchor.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Downtown VW
Fee-simple lots

items.t: No fee-simple house-lot stock exists to document in the VW core: the Downtown District (DD) schedule of Zoning and Development By-law No. 3575 governs much of the core — the only permitted uses are those in the Downtown District Official Development Plan, including commercial, residential, institutional and light industrial uses, parks and open spaces, and public uses, with development permits approved by the Development Permit Board or the Director of Planning as the schedule states; CD-1 comprehensive development districts and C-3A districts also apply in parts of the area. The tenure position is overwhelmingly strata condominium form, with rental apartment buildings and hotel and office strata also in the mix.
Lot character — district position, as the schedules state them: VW-core parcels are governed by the DD, CD-1 and C-3A districts rather than house-lot minimums.
Serviced position: homes here are on City water and sewer services, as fully urban serviced stock.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Downtown VW

items.t: Downtown VW is the Vancouver West board side of the City of Vancouver's official "Downtown" local area — one of the City's 22 distinct areas — covering the central business district and the Georgia / Granville / Burrard / Robson core on Burrard Inlet's south shore. The City describes Downtown as a peninsula, bounded by Burrard Inlet on the north, False Creek and the district of Yaletown to the south, the West End neighbourhood and Stanley Park to the west, and the historic districts of Gastown, Chinatown and Strathcona to the east; the VW core within it is the central and western part of that peninsula.
Nearby areas: West End (west), Yaletown and False Creek (south), Coal Harbour (north-west waterfront), Gastown / Strathcona (east), and Mount Pleasant and Fairview (south, across False Creek).
Vancouver General Hospital, 899 West 12th Avenue, is in Fairview. The City Downtown page states Downtown houses many arts, entertainment and sports venues and is the city's primary business district.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Downtown VW

items.t: Zoning — Zoning and Development By-law No. 3575, Downtown District (DD) schedule: the DD position in, with CD-1 and C-3A districts also applying in parts of the area.

SSMUH / house-lot density: not a Downtown form — there are no house lots to densify; added residential capacity in the core runs through DD / CD-1 development permits, not small-scale multi-unit rules.
Floodplain standards: land in the City's designated floodplain is subject to the Vancouver Building By-law Floodplain Standards and Requirements for shoreline setbacks and flood construction levels.

Strata block (the operative tenure block for this area): Form B diligence (provided within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page); depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for stratas with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws void since November 24, 2022 (short-term restrictions may still apply by bylaw); only 55+ age bylaws valid under SPA ss.123.1/123.2, with May 1, 2023 exemptions; a listing's "45+" line is not a valid BC age bylaw. For strata purchases, review the depreciation report, contingency reserve and any special levies before pricing an offer; BC strata disputes can go to the Civil Resolution Tribunal.

ALR rules (for completeness — no Downtown VW ALR parcel is confirmed here): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm class is three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an error.

City of Vancouver property taxes + additional school tax: 2026 advance taxes were due February 3, 2026 and main taxes were due July 3, 2026, with a 5% penalty on the unpaid balance after each due date; the home owner grant was also due July 3, 2026. At VW-core price points the additional school tax can apply — 0.2% on the residential portion between $3 million and $4 million and 0.4% above $4 million for 2026, rising to 0.3% and 0.6% on January 1, 2027.
